inputs: published force, world footprint and measured bottom for each ten completed .2ms ticks
backend: batched GPU layout 1/column plus original CPU force correction, or original CPU native full packet. Adaptive routes by floor(log2(cell count)) and synchronous native recent times in that bin; periodic alternate observation.
scope: actual independent closed-loop MuJoCo runs with nominal R60 MPC/WBC consuming M1 inverse normal references
